description: ManualProcessIdentityCheckBanner renders the four resolution actions required by manual_process_identity_check_ui_v1: Copy Diagnostic, Retry Identity Check, Mark Process Absent, and Open Provider Session Evidence.
assertions: copy_diagnostic action rendered and invokable: copies provider_session_id, cancellation_epoch, process_fate, last_seen_pid, process_start_identity hash, and latest receipt id with secrets redacted
retry_identity_check action rendered: runs read-only process identity probe and refreshes readback without issuing shutdown signals
mark_process_absent action rendered: requires operator confirmation and CallerRequestId; backend confirms absence before setting process_fate to absent_verified
open_provider_session_evidence action rendered: opens the evidence panel anchored to the focused lifecycle window
no automatic retry spinner present for held identity_ambiguous state
actions disabled after hold is cleared by backend — banner clears only after backend readback moves intent_state away from held or process_fate away from identity_ambiguous
VoiceOver announces title, provider display name, reason, and focused action

resolution_actions.effect: Copies provider_session_id, cancellation_epoch, process_fate, last_seen_pid, process_start_identity hash, and latest receipt id with secrets redacted
Runs a read-only process identity probe and refreshes readback; does not issue shutdown signals
Requires operator confirmation and CallerRequestId; if backend confirms absence, moves process_fate to absent_verified and resumes settlement
Opens the evidence panel anchored to the focused lifecycle window
